title.en: senior-level applications: my track record, I would welcome the opportunity, I am confident that

explain.ko: 고급 직책의 지원서와 커버 레터는 경력을 나열하는 대신 성과를 구체적인 수치와 함께 보여 주는 것이 핵심입니다. 구조는 지원 의사, 경력 요약, 대표 성과, 회사에 대한 기여, 마무리입니다. 동사는 spearhead, oversee, lead, implement처럼 주도성을 보여 주는 것을 쓰고, I am confident that ..., I would welcome the opportunity to ... 같은 정중하고 자신감 있는 표현을 사용합니다. 과장보다 근거가 중요합니다.
explain.en: For senior applications and cover letters, show achievements with concrete figures rather than listing duties. The structure is application, experience summary, key achievement, contribution to the company and closing. Use verbs that show initiative (spearhead, oversee, lead, implement) and polite, confident phrases such as I am confident that ... and I would welcome the opportunity to .... Evidence matters more than exaggeration.

prompt.en: Write four key sentences for a senior-level job application: application, experience, achievement, closing.

task.model: I wish to apply for the position of Sales Director. I have a proven track record leading teams over ten years. My greatest achievement was spearheading a project to enter a new market, which raised sales by thirty per cent. I would welcome the opportunity to attend an interview.

model_trans.en: I wish to apply for the position of Sales Director. I have a proven track record leading teams over ten years. My greatest achievement was spearheading a project to enter a new market, which raised sales by thirty per cent. I would welcome the opportunity to attend an interview.
